entries.text: 海岱没带钱包，\n现在一定正在哭鼻子呢……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: 拜托你穿过沙漠，\n到[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]渍沁镇[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]后把钱包交给他吧！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: 怎么？你又来了！？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01a

entries.text: 这样下去，\n特卖商品会被别人买走的……[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_28

entries.text: 大哥，你要冷静！\n我跑一趟，马上找回它就是了！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01b

entries.text: 哦，你要怎样？\n要是找海岱大哥有事的话，\r\n他现在正忙着呢！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_02

entries.text: 要是想碍事的话，不管是谁，\n我这个头号弟子都不会允许……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_03

entries.text: 还是说，即使你看我们这～么忙\n……也还是有事要找我们吗！？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_04

entries.text: 有事！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_a

entries.text: 没事……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_b

entries.text: 那么，你就快回去！\n我们可是很忙的！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_05

entries.text: 你这孩子真不懂事！\n让你安静一点吧！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_06

entries.text: 怎么会这样！\n我连私房钱都输了个精光！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_07

entries.text: 嘿！吃了吗……\n这么吵，出啥事了……？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_01

entries.text: 海、海岱大哥！\n事情是这样的，这孩子……
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_08

entries.text: 有客人来找丢了钱包\n身无分文的俺……？\r\n到底有啥事啊……？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_02

entries.text: 钱包！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_01

entries.text: 你忘了这个！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]把海岱的钱包\n交给了道馆馆主！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_system_01

entries.text: 啥？是道馆前台的人\n让你给俺送来的？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_04

entries.text: 啊、哈、哈！你帮了俺一个大忙！\n特地让你跑一趟，多谢啦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_05

entries.text: 啊～还有，俺的小弟\n给你添麻烦了，抱歉！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_06

entries.text: 在渍沁镇招牌的[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]拍卖会[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]上\n有俺们无论如何都想买的东西。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_07

entries.text: 所以俺跟他都很兴奋。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_08

entries.text: 来啊！瞧一瞧！看一看！\n这是今天最后一件商品！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_shop_01

entries.text: 今天的特卖商品是这个！\n丰缘地区产的传说的裙带菜！\r\n有没有？有没有？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_shop_02

entries.text: 俺不摸也能看出来的\n那富含营养的弹力！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_11

entries.text: 那光彩四射，\n耀眼夺目的色泽！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_12

entries.text: 还有既新鲜又醇厚，\n来自海边的那股藏不住的芳香！！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_13

entries.text: 俺说你啊，如果想挑战玻瓶道馆，\n够不够洒脱是很重要的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_15

entries.text: 这是个好机会！\n你就替俺拍下那个食材吧！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_16

entries.text: 什么是拍卖？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_03

entries.text: 我试试看！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_04

entries.text:
拍卖啊……就是通过和其他客人
竞拍来买东西的意思！\c
在自己能拿得出手的范围内，
用更高的价格投标的人
就能把商品买下！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_17

entries.text: 啊、哈、哈！你小小年纪\n却知道什么是拍卖吗！？\r\n好强的孩子啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_18

entries.text: 这是用来拍卖的经费！\n要多动脑筋，把它拍下来啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_19

entries.text: 那就开始了！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_01

entries.text: 丰缘地区产的传说的裙带菜！\n起步价[VAR 0x0205(0001,0000)]！
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_02

entries.text: 现在的价格是[VAR 0x0205(0002,0000)]……\n要用多少钱投标？
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_system_01

entries.text: 观望
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_select_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_a_01_old

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_b_01_old

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_c_01_old

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_a_02_old

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_b_02_old

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_c_02_old

entries.text: 你让大人都甘拜下风了！\n哦～！真是太了不起啦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_20

entries.text: 你拍下的裙带菜，\n俺就心存感激地收下了。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_21

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]把传说的裙带菜\n交给了海岱。
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_system_02

entries.text: 多好的东西！\n要是没得到它的话，\r\n肯定会让俺牵肠挂肚的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_22

entries.text:
没用完的经费
你就收下当零花钱用吧！\c
有兴趣的话，你可以
用在其他的拍卖上！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_23

entries.text: ……那么，\n俺就先回玻瓶道馆了。[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_24

entries.text: 男子汉海岱！\n会准备生猛的对战等你来的！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_25
